title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0040e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.000980
  m_eff = 2.3499e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2631e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.4870 s⁻¹
  k = 0.4327 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.888352 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -3.419e-2
  J_spin = -1.382e-1
